summary: Defines how IPv6 packets are carried over PPP links, including the control protocol that sets up IPv6 and how link-local addresses are formed. It replaces RFC 2023. It is a proposed standard that was replaced by RFC 5072 and RFC 5172.

eli5.summary: PPP is like a direct line between two computers. This explains how to use that line for IPv6 and how each end gets its local address.

questions: how does ipv6 work over ppp
